notes: Local hardware prices are Australian retail in AUD including GST. Cloud GPU rates are USD per GPU-hour and are converted on the page.

local.name: GeForce RTX 5090

local.aud_note: ASUS Ascent GX10 1TB at Centrecom. Founders Edition 4TB is about A$8,999.

local.name: RTX PRO 6000 (96 GB)
local.aud_note: PCCaseGear workstation edition. Other retailers list A$20,999 to A$34,499.

local.name: Mac Studio M5 Ultra (256 GB)
local.aud_note: Top configuration currently on sale in Australia. A 512GB option is due in late October, price not yet announced.

cloud_note: These are global marketplace rates. Sydney-region capacity usually costs more and is scarcer. Australian sovereign options include SCX.ai (Equinix SY5, Sydney) and SharonAI.
